requirements.description: Energy class C or better, as explicitly requested by the user. Gross floor area (850 sqm), capacity (60 people), public transport proximity and the CDP/PNRR program are not energy-related columns and are not filtered here.
User explicitly requires the building to be near public transport. Value is the 75th percentile of mobility (70.93), rounded to 71.
The building is to be converted into a university student residence, so proximity to schools and universities is clearly necessary. Value is the 75th percentile of education (75.14), rounded to 75.

The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area, so this is a direct surface threshold. The capacity of 60 people is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-property-area threshold was supplied by the RegulatoryAgent. Turin is a city, not a cadastral code, so comune_code is not set and the location is left to the Location Agent. Energy class, public transport proximity, and the CDP/PNRR funding purpose are outside the reference columns and are not used as filters.
